rss: Plug-in solar panels are coming to a shop near you - here's what to know
title: New Solar Panels for Homes
story: New solar panels are here to help families save money on their energy bills. They can plug right into your house and use sunlight to make electricity!
storyBig: New plug-in solar panels have become available, promising significant savings on household energy bills by harnessing solar power. This innovation represents a shift in the energy industry towards more sustainable and cost-effective solutions.
think: How can solar energy help save money?
bull: Solar panels can help families pay less for electricity.
bear: Solar panels might be expensive to buy at first.

rss: Nvidia revenue doubles on continued AI demand
title: Robot Chip Demand Soars
story: People want more robot chips to make their gadgets smarter. This is helping companies that make these chips earn a lot more money!
storyBig: The demand for AI-related technology has led to a significant increase in revenue for chip manufacturers. As more industries integrate AI, the market for advanced chips continues to grow, driving substantial financial gains.
think: Why do you think smart gadgets are popular?
bull: Smart gadgets make life easier and more fun!
bear: Too much gadget use might not be good for us.
